d: It is the morning. A room in the Governor's house. At the end the entrance of his rooms. Deputies, Gentiluomini, Populari, Uffiziali; on the front Samuel, Tom and their adherents, all waiting for Riccardo. Chorus, Samuel, Tom.
Oscar from the Count's rooms, then Richard and sayings. Oscar, Richard.
Richard, Renato.
Oscar, Judge and sayings.
Samuel, Tom, Chorus and sayings.
The habit of the fortune teller. On the left, a fireplace; the fire is on. The boiler smokes over a tripe. Ulric near. Chorus, Ulric.
Riccardo comes in dressed as a fisherman, advancing between the Folla, not seeing any of his. Riccardo and sayings.
Silvano and sayings.
Amelia, Ulrica and Riccardo on the side.
Ulrica opens the main entrance: enter Samuel, Tom and Seguaci, Oscar, Gentiluomini and Uffiziali disguised bizarrely, to which Riccardo joins. Ulrica, Chorus, Samuel, Tom, Oscar, Riccardo.
Renato appears at the entrance. Richard comes to him and shakes his hand. Renato and sayings.
Silvano and sayings.
Lonely field around Boston is a steep hill. On the left in the lower whiteness two pillars; and the slightly veiled moon illuminates some points of the scene. Amelia.
Richard and Amelia.
Riccardo, Amelia and Renato.
Renato and Amelia.
Samuel, Tom with Séguito, from the heights, and sayings.

A study room in the house of Renato. Over a fireplace next to two bronze vases, opposite which the library. In the bottom there is a magnificent portrait of Count Riccardo standing, and in the middle of the scene, a table. Renato and Amelia enter.
Renato; Samuel and Tom come in and greet him coldly.
Amelia and sayings.
Oscar and sayings.
Sumptuous cabinet of the Count. Table with the necessities to register; at the bottom a great courtyard that will discover the dance party. Riccardo alone.
Oscar with a letter, that's it.

A vast and rich ballroom beautifully lit and party parade. Musical lyes prelude to dances; and already at the opening of the curtains a multitude of Invited ungodly scene. The greatest number is in mask, some in dominò, others in gala costume with open face; among the Dancing Couple some young creoles. Who goes on track, who avoids, who respects and who pursues. The service is done by blacks, and everything breathes magnificence and hilarity. Chorus.
Samuel, Tom and their adherents in blue dominated with a vermilion girdle. Renato in the same costume slowly progressed. Samuel, Tom, Renato, Oscar, Amelia, Riccardo, Chorus.
